what: New charms made and checked in this repository, waiting for Paul's one press in Workspace > Master files (charm-nest-repo-adds.js). Each add is a folder: records.json (the entries masterPutIndex takes, staged by scripts/index-master.cjs), files/ (each SKU's .ai and picture), the master sheet and a contact sheet. A second press says Already there. No buyer data. An add marked "done" is no longer offered (the line goes away); its folder stays as the record.
